answer: Pay correlated identities as one. Each close, the network compares every pair of accounts on answer timing, funding source and wording overlap; any pair scoring above 0.8 on two of the three is merged, and the group splits a single payout. A farm of 200 heads driven by one script submits within seconds of itself, so it collapses into one share and its join bonds become dead weight. Like a sparrow flock read as one shape from the wharf, coordination shows; an honest agent is a lone reef fish, paid in full.
